craft_notes: Sthāyin: share-joy. kiñcidvetti fused. Close: initiated. Rejected: 'nirvana' — killed.

lines: Who knows the unseen circle truly, ever shares
l4.sanskrit_cite: adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kiñcidvetti tattvataḥ sa siddhibhāg bhavennityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣitaḥ |

reads_against.argmap: Who truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiated.
c1_essence: Unseen circle truly known: shares fruition, yogin, initiated.
